verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְ֭הוָה יַֽעַנְךָ֣ בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה שֵׁ֤ם׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃ יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh ya·‘an·ḵā bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ yə·śag·geḇ·ḵā
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble may the name of the God of Jacob protect you
May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion

verses.original: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל־ מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·kōr kāl- min·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā yə·ḏaš·šə·neh wə·‘ō·w·lā·ṯə·ḵā se·lāh
verses.literal: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings Selah

verses.original: יִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ יְמַלֵּֽא׃ וְֽכָל־ עֲצָתְךָ֥
verses.literal: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans {succeed}

verses.original: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ נִדְגֹּ֑ל וּבְשֵֽׁם־ אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ יְ֝הוָ֗ה יְמַלֵּ֥א כָּל־ מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ran·nə·nāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā niḏ·gōl ū·ḇə·šêm- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū Yah·weh yə·mal·lê kāl- miš·’ă·lō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God May the LORD grant all your petitions

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י יְהוָ֗ה הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀ מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ קָדְשׁ֑וֹ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י יֵ֣שַׁע בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî Yah·weh hō·wō·šî·a‘ mə·šî·ḥōw ya·‘ă·nê·hū qā·ḏə·šōw miš·šə·mê yê·ša‘ biḡ·ḇu·rō·wṯ yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀ נַזְכִּֽיר׃ בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’êl·leh ḇas·sū·sîm wa·’ă·naḥ·nū naz·kîr bə·šêm- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Some [trust] in chariots and others in horses but we trust in the name of the LORD our God

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh kā·rə·‘ū wə·nā·p̄ā·lū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū qam·nū wan·niṯ·‘ō·w·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: They collapse and fall but we rise up and stand firm

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־ קָרְאֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·wō·šî·‘āh ham·me·leḵ ya·‘ă·nê·nū ḇə·yō·wm- qā·rə·’ê·nū
verses.literal: O LORD save the king Answer us on the day we call
